para.text: National Association of Securities Dealers (NASD) Members. An applicant that is already a member of, or has applied for membership in, the NASD shall:

File with the Central Registration Depository System (CRD) the information required by Form BD (Uniform Application for Broker-Dealer Registration) and the fee required by the Maryland Securities Act, Corporations and Associations Article, §11-407, Annotated Code of Maryland; and
File with the Commissioner other information the Commissioner may reasonably require.
An applicant that is not a member of, or has not applied for membership in, the NASD shall file with the Commissioner an application upon Form BD (Uniform Application for Broker-Dealer Registration).

A financial statement prepared in accordance with 17 CFR §240.17a-5(d) (SEC Rule 17a-5(d), Annual Filing of Audited Financial Statements), which is incorporated by reference, as of a date within 90 days of the date on which the statement is filed;
If the applicant is a corporation, a resolution authorizing the filing of the application;
The fee required by the Maryland Securities Act, Corporations and Associations Article, §11-407, Annotated Code of Maryland;
A statement or certificate showing compliance with, or exemption from, the examination requirement of Regulation .06 of this chapter; and
Other information the Commissioner may reasonably require.

Completion of Filing. An application for initial registration as a broker-dealer is not considered filed for purposes of the Maryland Securities Act, Corporations and Associations Article, §11-405, Annotated Code of Maryland, until:
The applicant has complied with the examination requirement of Regulation .06 of this chapter;
The required fee and all required submissions have been received by the Commissioner;
If the applicant is seeking membership in the NASD, the applicant is approved as a member of the NASD; and
The applicant has submitted any other information the Commissioner has requested.
